audit_items.proof_trace: The CORS configuration falls back to wildcard ('*') when ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset, with no NODE_ENV guard anywhere in the codebase. startServer() validates DISCORD_TOKEN but performs no analogous check for ALLOWED_ORIGINS, so a production deployment missing that env var silently activates wildcard CORS alongside credentials: true. No enforcement mechanism exists for the property.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If ALLOWED_ORIGINS is omitted from production environment variables, the server responds with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; non-browser clients (server-side scripts, mobile apps) are not subject to browser CORS restrictions and can freely send cross-origin credentialed requests to any API endpoint.
